note: No commit handler yet. Maps to policy_transactions. This is a read-only audit record of what happened historically in the legacy system - it must NOT be used to drive current policy state (that is policy.json/policy_term.json's job through the real lifecycle). Treat this as backfilling the audit trail after the current-state import has already completed.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Must match this codebase's txn_type_enum values exactly (NB, ENDORSE, CANCEL, REINSTATE, REWRITE, RENEW, NON_RENEWAL - all uppercase).

fields.name: processedAt
fields.description: Original processed timestamp from the legacy system, preserved for audit - distinct from effectiveDate.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Legacy system's own record of the transaction, kept as-is for audit rather than reshaped.
